Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as molecule_chembl_id, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum clinical phase as max_phase, molecule type as molecule_type, and canonical SMILES as canonical_smiles for all compounds associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by document ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL4257575. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls for missing structures. Sort results by molecule ChEMBL identifier in ascending order.
